comments.body:
This is an item effect that comes from both consumable items:

1. Decorative Small Boat Blueprint, the consumable item which automatically obtained when entering legacy inland "Temple of Artemis in Ephesus".
2. Decorative Celestial Globe Anchor Blueprint, the consumable item which automatically obtained when entering legacy inland オリンピアのゼウス神殿.

See the respective link for the effect details.
